_comment: Structured key-value store for form fields that recur across applications (Goal/FORM-FIELDS spec). Two states: a non-empty value is used directly; an empty string "" is a KNOWN field the user has NOT filled yet. On encountering an empty key during form-filling, cvflow must NOT guess — it adds the key to a pending list and asks the user to fill it later (it does not block the application if the markdown KB can answer instead).
work_authorization: Authorized to work in the US (no sponsorship required)
